title: Reset Password
content: Users can reset their password by going to Settings, opening Security, and selecting Reset Password. A password reset email is sent to the registered email address. If the reset email does not arrive, users should check the spam folder or request another reset link.

title: Account Creation
content: New users can create an account by clicking Sign Up on the homepage. They must enter a valid email address, create a password, and verify their email before logging in for the first time.

title: Subscription Upgrade
content: Users can upgrade their subscription from the Billing section in account settings. Available plans include Basic, Pro, and Enterprise. Payment methods include credit card and UPI.

title: Refund Policy
content: Refund requests can be submitted within seven days of subscription purchase. Refunds are reviewed only if the user has not exceeded the usage limit of the purchased plan.

title: Two-Factor Authentication
content: Users can enable two-factor authentication in Settings under the Security tab. Once enabled, each login requires both the password and a one-time verification code sent to the user's device.

title: Profile Update
content: Users can update their profile information such as name, phone number, and profile photo in the Profile section of account settings. Changes are saved immediately after submission.
